name: Divine Retribution
summary: Kalaran Windblade asks you to hear his tale in Searing Gorge. His father is dead at the hands of what lurks in the cauldron, and the Stormwind magistrate would not listen. Kalaran seeks vengeance and wants an adventurer to act for him.

sections.title: A Father Slain
sections.body: Kalaran says the filth in the cauldron killed his father. He pleaded with the Stormwind magistrate for help, but the pleas fell on deaf ears. Stormwind, he says, would rather not admit this part of the world exists, let alone send soldiers to see justice done here.

sections.title: A Call for Vengeance
sections.body: Kalaran wants vengeance, plain and simple. He stands alone apart from a lumbering oaf of a squire, and the Dark Iron dwarves, along with Ragnaros's beasts, would crush him by himself. He trusts that a brave adventurer could handle the denizens of the cauldron, and he promises riches and wealth beyond all dreams to whoever helps.

faq.answer: Kalaran Windblade is a man in Searing Gorge whose father was slain, and who seeks vengeance. He has a squire with him.
Kalaran blames the filth living in the cauldron for his father's death, and he wants vengeance.
Kalaran says the Stormwind magistrate ignored his pleas. By his account Stormwind does not wish to admit this part of the world exists, much less send soldiers to see justice done.
He names the Dark Iron dwarves and Ragnaros's beasts, and says either would overwhelm him alone.

faq.q: What does Kalaran promise in exchange for help?
faq.answer: He promises riches and wealth beyond anyone's wildest dreams to a brave adventurer who helps him.
